preconditions.description: The number of plates n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The maximum number of plates that can be moved from the dirty stack to the intermediate stack in one operation is between 1 and n inclusive.
The maximum number of plates that can be moved from the intermediate stack to the dryer in one operation is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of plate sizes provided matches the number of plates n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= size <= n for size in sizes)
preconditions.description: Each plate size is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output starts with either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == (stdout.count('\n') >= 2 and all(line.split()[0] in ['1', '2'] and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdout.split('\n')[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', it is followed by an integer k and k lines describing valid operations.
If the output starts with 'YES', the second line is an integer k representing the number of operations, and there are k operation lines.
If the output starts with 'NO', it is followed by no additional lines.
